Name: Non-Alcoholic Shane Mod
Author: LuckyTiamat
Description:
During your courtship of Shane, he slowly realizes his own alcoholism and sobers up. But after you marry him, he mentions drinking even though he's supposedly sober. 

This mod aims to fix that, changing any mentions of drinking from his post-marriage dialogue, cleaning up his room, and allowing him to give you Jojo Cola and Ginger Ale instead of beer and pale ale.





This is my first time modding anything, so feel free to leave feedback, I will do my best to fix any bugs that crop up!

Downloads.Description: The first version of the mod! Please submit a bug report if any dialogue slipped through the cracks.
